rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the emotional power that makes something move people.

example.english: This singer gives the song so much pathos that we all get teary-eyed.

rows.note: Use this when highlighting the particular touching quality or aspect of a story, performance, or person.

example.english: The most memorable pathos of this film is the mother waiting at the door for her son to come home.

rows.note: Use this when the pathos specifically comes from sadness, pity, or a tragic situation.

example.english: The pathos of a family separated during war moved countless viewers.
